about_the_game:
About

Team up in a chaotic 2–4 player co-op RC car adventure!

You and your friends are tethered together on rugged mountain trails. The rope is your lifeline yank a teammate back from a fall, anchor on climbs. Wind, ice and many more obstacles keep pushing you off line only communication and timing will get the crew to the summit.

Demo Version

This demo lets you play through the entire first region, Grasslands, and a preview section of the Snowy Mountain area.

It includes all core gameplay however it does not include later levels on this demo version.

Your feedback from this demo will help us polish and expand the full game.

Co-op, but literally tied together

Every car shares a rope. Use it to rescue, stabilize or boost and sometimes all three at the same time.

2–4 players, maximum chaos

Built for laughter, panic and clutch saves. Perfect for party nights or short sessions.

Physics-driven RC handling

Lightweight grip, momentum, and weight transfer you can feel. Nudge, counter-steer and recover together.

Mountain routes & wild weather

Cliffside paths, wooden bridges, steep switchbacks, snowfields, lava lakes and mud. Wind, rain and fog change how the run feels.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS *: Windows 8/10/11 (64-Bit)
  • Processor: Intel i3-4170 @ 3.7Ghz OR Intel i5 750 @ 2.67Ghz
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVidia 650TI OR AMD R7 250x
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 1500 MB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS *: Windows 8/10/11 (64-Bit)
  • Processor: Intel i5 750 @ 2.67Ghz or higher
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVidia GTX 970 OR NVidia GTX 1060 3GB OR AMD R9 290x OR AMD RX 470
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 1500 MB available space

short_description: Team up in this chaotic 2-4 player co-op RC car adventure! Navigate dangerous mountain roads while tethered together, pulling each other back from disaster. Climb steep hills, survive wild weather, and reach the top without tumbling into the abyss!
supported_languages: English, French, German, Japanese, Korean, Polish, Portuguese - Portugal, Russian, Simplified Chinese, Spanish - Latin America, Swedish, Turkish, Ukrainian
